title: Six-class secp256k1 rho at 125.83434453: R=2^34 with a pathwise waste bound on every catch of length <=32 (256-walk exact accounting)

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold six-class negation-plus-GLV parallel rho algorithm of proof.md/upstream-proof.md stops on every run within 2^125.83434453 target-group-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit). Claim 125.83434453 is the eight-decimal ceiling of the exact ledger 2^125.834344521. Under disclosed H1, borrow premise C and catch premise P1, recovery probability is at least 0.39000001. Parameters: M=2^23, R=2^34, kappa=1.0000403, w=2^-22.00, p0=0.39001172, Markov allowance A_r=ceil(E_r/0.0000116). C bounds expected dx,dy,u borrows by (1/2+2^-10,1/2+2^-11,1/2+2^-11)E[L]; P1 bounds the expected catches of length <=32 by E[L]/(4R) and is measured on doublings of any cycle length. The kappa-rule waste is pathwise: 5.5's Ville lemma bounds all catches of length <=32 by (1+2^-11)q'(S+2^61), and charging every catch the worst-case 16,158 wasted arrivals gives realised waste (1+2^-11)*16,158/(4R) < 2^-22.019 < w outside one 2^-140 event, not only in expectation. The R=2^34 partition table (2^48 hard row, 2^47.1 preprocessing, 2^44 bytes, aligned to 2^44) and its 35-bit BFI slot index are shipped in kernels/; the declared experiment executes the widened 35-bit slot index and the unchanged loop counts. Memory <2^72 bytes; preprocessing capped at 2^59 units and included; no advice. Direct base: accepted 3edc7a00 (125.8343446), after aa9c2b68 (125.834345), db13717f (125.834346) and c8a6819e (branch 9f06f2bf, 125.834417), whose credited packages are declared where materially reused. The declared initial experiment and certificate ran separately (evidence.md); the ledger is recomputed in certificate.py. Analytic heuristic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Check production identities, a time-limited toy pipeline, interpreter execution of the shipped kernels and exits against reference arithmetic, counts, ledger and census rules. This is not a production-scale attack; evidence.md describes limitations.
